laws.rule: Tortuguero: daily 6 am to noon and 1 pm to 4 pm. Non-resident adults US$16.95 (about A$24.08 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), children US$5.65 (about A$8.03 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026); Cerro Tortuguero trail US$2.26 (about A$3.21 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Beach access is restricted 6 pm to 6 am from 1 March to 31 October to protect nesting turtles. No drugs or alcohol, sound equipment, fires, weapons, fishing or pets.
laws.heading: Parque Nacional Tortuguero

laws.rule: Parque Nacional Cahuita: Playa Blanca and Puerto Vargas sectors have published daily hours 08:00-16:00. Stay on trails and never stand on coral. SINAC recommends a local guide; it does not make that recommendation a mandatory guide requirement in this passage.
